nodes.name: Global Config
nodes.notes: ⚙️ Keys + bucket + signed-URL TTL. deploy-workflow.mjs injects real keys (Starter plan has no Variables).

nodes.name: Verify initData
nodes.notes: #56 fail-closed HMAC. Resolves the Telegram user id from the signature, never from the request body.

nodes.name: Get Identity
nodes.notes: Resolve telegram id → profile UUID (mirror form-submit Get Profile). cases.user_id holds this UUID, not the raw telegram id. Empty → Assert returns not_owner.

nodes.name: Get Case
nodes.notes: Load the case by id (service-role). alwaysOutputData → empty result still passes one item so Assert can return case_not_found.

nodes.name: Assert & Decide
nodes.notes: Owner + ready gate. _ok:false on any failure → 4xx, paid untouched. Builds the idempotent PATCH body.

nodes.name: Set Paid
nodes.notes: Flip paid=true,status=paid. paid_at written ONLY on the first flip (idempotent re-mint preserves it).

nodes.name: Mint Signed URL
nodes.notes: Server-side signed URL on the private bucket (service-role). TTL 24h (A3). Client never sees the storage key.

nodes.name: Build Response
nodes.notes: Assemble absolute signed URL + expires_at; carry the opt-in delivery flag.

nodes.name: Send to bot?
nodes.notes: GDPR opt-in (invariant 7): true ONLY when the request carried deliver_to_bot===true. Default path skips the bot.

nodes.name: Download PDF
nodes.notes: Fetch the PDF as binary. The ?download=<name> on the URL sets Content-Disposition, so n8n names the binary «Позовна заява.pdf» — which Telegram then shows (sending by URL would show the raw case-id path instead).

nodes.name: Send PDF
nodes.notes: Opt-in bot delivery: multipart upload of the downloaded binary (keeps the friendly filename). 0-cred — token from Global Config. onError=continue so a Telegram hiccup still returns the URL.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, signed_url: $('Build Response').first().json._signed_url, expires_at: $('Build Response').first().json._expires_at }) }}

nodes.name: Respond Error

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: $json._error, reason: $json._reason || null, message: 'Технічні труднощі. Спробуйте, будь ласка, пізніше.' }) }}

nodes.notes: Single 4xx for every business rejection (auth / not-owner / not-ready). paid is NEVER flipped on this path.
